I've attached the PO excerpt and a short list of CloudPoint's standard clauses.

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor flow-down: CloudPoint MSA change & subprocessor approval

Vanessa / team — attaching our proposed redline to the MSA that specifically addresses: 1) subprocessor flow-down obligations, 2) notice timing for new subprocessors, 3) audit rights and remediation scope, and 4) DPA binding language for downstream providers.

Summary of key recommendations (TL;DR):
- We will accept a flow-down that requires vendors to "observe equivalent obligations" to our DPA (preferred) rather than literal downstream inclusion of CloudPoint's DPA text. This preserves operational feasibility for our subprocessors.
- Notice window: propose 45-day notice for new subprocessors to customers (counter-offer to their 30 days) with an explicit objection channel; rationale: gives us time to notify and remediate, and to identify replacement vendors if needed.
- Audit / certification: accept third-party audit rights limited to SOC2 reports and scoped to the data processing activities relevant to CloudPoint's account; technical access or intrusive audits require a written scope and Redwood approval.
- For Dedicated/Private deployments: require customer to use Redwood Private-specific flowdown language and sign the Order Form with explicit hosting location constraints.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx
Action items: Vanessa to confirm if procurement can accept 45-day counter; Rishi to confirm technical limits on audit access (logs, KMS, HSM).

- Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx (redlines), summary_playbook.docx (internal)

2) CloudPoint has asked for a signed order form to close the commercial side — is the Order Form in scope for the same flow-down changes, or do the flow-downs only live in the master MSA?

I've attached the vendor questionnaire CloudPoint asked subprocessors to complete.
